location_description: Deptford Township (pronounced DEP-ford) is a township in Gloucester County, New Jersey. As of the 2010 U.S. census, the township's population was 30,561, reflecting an increase of 3,798 (+14.2%) from the 26,763 counted in the 2000 census. Geographically, the township is part of the South Jersey region.
